local-db.description: Access to the local development database for schema inspection and query execution.

local-db-readonly.description: Read-only access to local database for safe schema exploration (connects as a read-only database role).

_comments.usage: Replace the host, port, database, and user values with your actual database details
_comments.security: Never commit actual credentials. Use environment variables or secrets management.
_comments.server: Matches Chapter Listing 5-1: MCP Toolbox for Databases, the maintained successor to the archived reference mcp/postgres image. Servers age; check the MCP registry for current entries.
_comments.readonly: Read-only enforcement lives in the database: create a role with SELECT-only grants and connect as that role.
